text:
Maya (Product): quick async — Q2 anchorpoint check. Need a compact update on: what shipped this sprint, what slipped, owners for remaining rollouts, and any blocker deps. Pinged execs; I just need an EOD summary.

Tom (Eng): shipped: routing fallback rollout (canary at 10%) and billing UI v2 behind flag :shipit:. slipped: autoscale policy tuning — hit a regression with short bursts (PRs in review). Owner: Tom for routing, Lina for autoscale.

Lina (Eng-Platform): autoscale slip root cause = premature cooldown resetting K8s HPA metrics after burst. Fix is in branch `autoscale-fix-179` — need SRE to validate HPA thresholds in staging. PR: #4123. ETA review->merge today if Raj can validate.

Raj (Eng-SRE): I can validate staging tonight. Noted the HPA spike logs — will run load script and report results. Also saw two pod OOMs during the canary; they correlate with kv-cache size. Suggest temporary cache cap to avoid tail OOMs.

Evan (PM): backlog note — billing UI rollout blocked on backend migration (DB index). Backend team says migration safe but needs 2hr maintenance window. Can we align next Tue 01:00–03:00 UTC?

Tom (Eng): re: OOMs — lowering kv-cache cap is low-risk short-term. I'll cut a hotfix PR after Lina/Lift confirm autoscale change. @Raj can you confirm if lowering cache to 256MB avoids the OOMs in a quick run?

Raj (Eng-SRE): will run a smoke with cache=256MB and HPA changes. Will post results here by 18:00 UTC.

Sofia (Design): heads-up — billing UI needs one micro copy tweak post-merge (billing page: header aligns left). I can ship the tiny patch after the backend is green.

Maya (Product): owners summary for EOD: routing fallback — Tom (on prod watch). autoscale tuning — Lina (+Raj validating). billing UI rollout — Evan coordinating maintenance with infra, Sofia on final copy. PRs to merge: #4123 (autoscale), #4130 (kv-cache cap hotfix), frontend flag release (Tom).

Tom (Eng): CR ping: @Lina please review #4130, small hotfix. Also pinging @Evan for final acceptance on billing copy after Sofia's tweak.

deploy-bot: deployment event: canary routing rollout started 2026-03-17T15:04:12Z — canary=10% — monitoring window 15m.

Maya (Product): thanks — if any of you hit a showstopper call it out and we'll escalate. Otherwise I'll collate and send to execs at 18:30 UTC. :pray:
